info.title: ProtoLIMS API

AssayCreate.title: AssayCreate
AssayCreate.description: Data needed to create an assay.

AssayRead.title: AssayRead
AssayRead.description: An assay as returned by the API, with where it belongs and how many samples it measured.

AssaySampleLink.title: AssaySampleLink
AssaySampleLink.description: Links a sample to an assay, or changes its label there.

AssaySampleRead.title: AssaySampleRead
AssaySampleRead.description: A sample measured in an assay, with its label there.

AssayUpdate.title: AssayUpdate
AssayUpdate.description:
Changes to an assay. Only the fields sent are changed; sending null clears a field.

The study can't be changed: an assay stays in the study it was created in.

DataFileCreate.title: DataFileCreate
DataFileCreate.description: Data needed to record a data file.

DataFileRead.title: DataFileRead
DataFileRead.description: A data file as returned by the API, with where it belongs and how many samples it holds.

DataFileSampleLink.title: DataFileSampleLink
DataFileSampleLink.description: Links a sample to a data file, or changes its label there.

DataFileSampleRead.title: DataFileSampleRead
DataFileSampleRead.description: A sample whose data is in a file, with its label there.

DataFileSummary.title: DataFileSummary
DataFileSummary.description: Enough about a data file to list and link to it, e.g. as another file's input.

DataFileUpdate.title: DataFileUpdate
DataFileUpdate.description:
Changes to a data file. Only the fields sent are changed; sending null clears a field.

The study can't be changed: a file record stays in the study it was created in.

DesignFactor.title: DesignFactor
DesignFactor.description: A variable under study, e.g. "compound", "dose" or "tissue type".

ProjectCreate.title: ProjectCreate
ProjectCreate.description: Data needed to create a project.

ProjectRead.title: ProjectRead
ProjectRead.description: A project as returned by the API.

ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate
ProjectUpdate.description:
Changes to a project. Only the fields sent are changed; sending null clears a field.

The code can't be changed, because it's part of the project's address and its studies'.

SampleAssayRead.title: SampleAssayRead
SampleAssayRead.description: An assay a sample was measured in, with the sample's label there.

SampleCreate.title: SampleCreate
SampleCreate.description: Data needed to create a sample.

SampleDataFileRead.title: SampleDataFileRead
SampleDataFileRead.description: A data file a sample appears in, with the sample's label there.

SampleRead.title: SampleRead
SampleRead.description: A sample as returned by the API, with where it belongs and what it's linked to.

SampleUpdate.title: SampleUpdate
SampleUpdate.description:
Changes to a sample. Only the fields sent are changed; sending null clears a field.

The study can't be changed: a sample stays in the study it was created in.

StudyCreate.title: StudyCreate
StudyCreate.description: Data needed to create a study.

StudyRead.title: StudyRead
StudyRead.description: A study as returned by the API.

StudyUpdate.title: StudyUpdate
StudyUpdate.description:
Changes to a study. Only the fields sent are changed; sending null clears the description.

The code can't be changed, because it's part of the study's address, and a study stays in
the project it was created in.

StudyWithProjectRead.title: StudyWithProjectRead
StudyWithProjectRead.description: A study plus its project's code and name, for lists that span projects.

SubjectCreate.title: SubjectCreate
SubjectCreate.description: Data needed to create a subject.

SubjectRead.title: SubjectRead
SubjectRead.description: A subject as returned by the API, with the codes of its study and project.

SubjectUpdate.title: SubjectUpdate
SubjectUpdate.description:
Changes to a subject. Only the fields sent are changed; sending null clears a field.

The study can't be changed: a subject stays in the study it was created in.
